dialogues.speaker: Training Ground Announcement
dialogues.text: "Some trainees have recently been complaining that training on the machines is getting dull, so we've added a new challenge program."

dialogues.speaker: Training Ground Announcement
dialogues.text: "Ram the 'Secret Source Dragon Idol' to gain points. Whoever tops the rankings will win a prize."

dialogues.speaker: Trainee Message
dialogues.text: "I get it, the key is explosivity! Ram into the idol and then charge forward forcefully, that's how you get the most points!"

dialogues.speaker: Trainee Message
dialogues.text: "If you listen to the guy above, you're sure to end up with broken bones... I'm happy to keep lifting weights."
